TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION

• Student growth review

• Analyses and diagnostics associated with the 2014-2015.

STUDENT GROWTH IN RHODE ISLAND
• Analyses conducted for rst time in 2008 and have been
performed annually since. Last performed for Fall 2013 NECAP
administration.

• Analyses conducted for both Mathematics and Reading.

• Student growth percentiles were calculated and used, particularly
as part of teacher evaluation work conducted under RttT.

• Student growth projections were calculated but not used as part
of accountability or reporting.targets for typical and higher growth
a year in advance.

THE TRANSITION TO PARCC

• SGP analyses are norm-referenced and don’t require a vertical
scale to be conducted. Depending upon whether results are
disseminated, a likely cause of confusion: “How can you calculate
growth across two different tests?”

• Other PARCC SGP states we’re conducting analyses for:
Massachusetts, New Jersey, Colorado

• The Center conducted meetings with both SBAC and PARCC
consortium members discussing issues related to calculating and
using growth during assessment transitions.
